info.title: Employee Hub API
info.description: REST API for the Employee Hub — HR, Payroll, Leave, Timesheets, Documents, Benefits, Performance & Notifications

get.summary: Get all timesheets (Manager/HR filtered by team)

post.summary: Add an entry to a timesheet

get.summary: Get all teams, optionally filtered by departmentId

post.summary: Create a team under a department
Generate monthly payslip with PAYE and UIF
Create a goal for an employee (Manager/HR)
Offboard an employee: terminate, cancel pending leave, deactivate benefits
Reset a password using a valid reset token
Exchange a refresh token for a new access + refresh token pair
Login and receive a JWT token
Request a password reset token for an email

patch.summary: Update own profile (name, phone, address, nationality, gender)

get.summary: Get salary history for an employee
Get current employee's salary increase requests
Get approved leaves for a given month (team calendar)
Get audit logs (HR_ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN), filterable by entity type, employee, date range

delete.summary: Delete an entry from a DRAFT timesheet
Cancel a leave request (employee only, must be PENDING)
